name: datasqrl
description: Agentic data engineering for operational data: plan, build, and verify real-time pipelines, data APIs, and data products with DataSQRL.

interface.shortDescription: Build and verify operational data pipelines, APIs, and data products
interface.longDescription: DataSQRL is an open-source harness for agentic data engineering on operational data: agents build real-time pipelines, data APIs, and data products; a compiler verifies them. Describe a data pipeline in plain English. The plugin turns it into a requirements document, runs the Dockerized DataSQRL agent to plan it, waits for your review, then implements, compiles, tests and verifies it. Small changes to an existing project go straight to a patch run, and finished projects deploy to DataSQRL Cloud.
defaultPrompt: Ingest order events from Kafka, enrich them with customer data, and serve each customer's orders through a GraphQL API.
Plan a DataSQRL pipeline from my requirements document.
Is my DataSQRL run still going?
